tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs thogs med ces bya ba hūm̐ nag bde gshegs snying po rtsal gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300

bde gshegs zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi// dkyil 'khor lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ru gang zhig gter kha gsar rnying gi /bka' brgyad rgyas bsdus gang la'ang sbyar rung ba'i// gsol 'debs byin rlabs thogs med rgyas bsdus gsum// de la dang po hūm̐ sgrub gsol 'debs ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang che mchog bka' brgyad lha rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje thod phreng rig pa 'dzin rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ las kyi dbang mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen grub chen brgyad rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pad 'byung chos rgyal yongs rdzogs bka' bab la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas ye shes bka' bab brgyad rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ yang sprul gter ston chos bdag bcas rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dgu ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mched rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐// bka' 'dus chos mchog rgyud lung man ngag la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bde gshegs 'dus pa zhi khro yongs rdzogs la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

bka' brgyad bye brag bka' srung rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum sgrib sbyong zhing*/ khyed kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par// dngos grub yongs rdzogs thob par byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/
ces pa 'di nyid hūm̐ sgrub tsam zhig dang*// las byang chung ngu spros med don du sbyar/// /
